name: io.github.sepehr071/shopino-mcp
title: Shopino
description: Unofficial read-only Shopino: search fashion across Iranian shops, compare prices, sizes, stock.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPINO_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for requests to shopino.app, or a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next. System proxy settings are ignored.
